(Banco de Talentos) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Outbound) - Vaga Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) | Presencial/RJ

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica ( ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de 09h às 18h | Escala: 5x2 (segunda a sexta) com eventuais escalas aos sábados (opcional).

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Caso queira saber mais:

  • Vem conhecer como começamos e o nosso propósito no YouTube .
  • Temos vários artigos, cursos e vídeos para o seu desenvolvimento no nosso Blog .
  • E pra ficar por dentro de todas as novidades, é só nos seguir no Twitter e Instagram.

Desenvolvemos medicamentos, dispositivos inteligentes e tecnologias inovadoras em áreas terapêuticas como Oncologia, Neurologia e Fertilidade. Nossas equipes trabalham juntas nos seis continentes com muita paixão e curiosidade para auxiliar os pacientes em todas as etapas da vida. Unir-se à nossa equipe de Cuidados com a Saúde significa fazer parte de uma cultura de trabalho diversificada, inclusiva e flexível, com grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e evolução profissional por todo o mundo.

O Seu Papel

  • Gestão de Desvios e CAPA: Realizar a coleta e análise de dados para abertura de desvios, controle de mudanças e gerenciamento de CAPAs (Ações Corretivas e Preventivas).

  • Auditoria e Compliance: Realizar a revisão de trilhas de auditoria e participar ativamente da preparação para auditorias externas e inspeções sanitárias.
  • Monitoramento de Produção: Acompanhar os processos produtivos em tempo real, garantindo o estrito cumprimento das normas vigentes e Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP).
  • Melhoria Contínua: Liderar pequenos projetos de otimização, auxiliando a coordenação no alcance dos KPIs (indicadores de performance) e na redução de reclamações de mercado.
  • Gestão Documental: Assegurar a atualização constante de SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão), PPs e demais documentos técnicos da área.
  • Representação Técnica: Realizar apresentações em reuniões multidisciplinares e responder tecnicamente por suas atividades perante autoridades sanitárias.

Quem é Você

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo (Farmácia, Eng. Química, Eng. Produção).
  • Conhecimento Normativo: Domínio de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP) e legislações sanitárias vigentes.
  • Inglês Avançado.
  • Experiências relevantes nas áreas de Qualidade, Produção, Tecnologia Farmacêutica e indústrias Farmacêuticas.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de investigar desvios complexos e analisar dados estatísticos com raciocínio lógico.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de realizar entregas com responsabilidade e tomar decisões técnicas seguras dentro de sua alçada.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade para relatar cenários técnicos de forma clara, objetiva e sem ambiguidades.

O que oferecemos

Somos mentes curiosas que vêm de uma ampla gama de origens, perspectivas e experiências de vida. Acreditamos que essa variedade impulsiona a excelência e a inovação, fortalecendo nossa capacidade de liderar em ciência e tecnologia. Estamos comprometidos em criar acesso e oportunidades para todos se desenvolverem e crescerem no seu próprio ritmo. Junte-se a nós para construir uma cultura de inclusão e pertencimento que impacta milhões e capacita todos a defender o progresso humano!

Candidate-se agora e torne-se parte de uma equipe dedicada a Despertar a Descoberta e Elevar a Humanidade!

  • Provide regular reports and presentations on Licensing & Retail activities, including sales performance, market insights, and recommendations for improvement, to senior management and stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.

We often say that our field engineers have the hardest job at Canonical because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. Location: This role will be based remotely in Japan (preferably in Tokyo or Osaka area).

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Elaborate solutions to be proposed to prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience (Yocto, Buildroot...) or RTOS
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
  • For positions in Japan and Korea, the successful candidates will also be able to speak and write the local language at a professional level.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with customer engagements a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

O Analista de RH será um agente de transformação e suporte que atuará dando apoio a atração, desenvolvimento e engajamento dos colaboradores, sendo essencial para manter um quadro de pessoal qualificado e motivado.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoio em Processos Seletivos de vagas estratégicas: Atuar no ciclo completo de recrutamento e seleção de vagas pontuais em diferentes níveis e áreas, desde a divulgação até a proposta, garantindo o fit cultural dos novos talentos.
  • Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento com profundidade e profissionalismo, analisando os dados coletados para fornecer insumos e insights estratégicos para a liderança, visando a elaboração de planos de ação de retenção de talentos e melhoria contínua do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Realizar o Levantamento de Necessidades de Treinamento (LNT) em parceria com as lideranças, identificando gaps de competências e definindo prioridades de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a criação, organização e execução de programas de desenvolvimento humano (treinamentos, workshops, mentorias), acompanhando a logística e a avaliação de eficácia para potencializar o desempenho e o crescimento das equipes.
  • Ser o ponto focal e o responsável pelo Endomarketing e Comunicação Interna, elaborando e executando um plano de comunicação coeso e atrativo (e-mails, murais, newsletters, canais internos), mantendo o time informado e engajado.
  • Conduzir rituais, eventos e estratégias de fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e dos valores da empresa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo, colaborativo e com senso de pertencimento.

HABILIDADES COMPORTAMENTAIS

1. Relacionamento Interpessoal
2. Visão Estratégica
3. Análise crítica
4. Senso de Inovação e urgência
5. Comunicação Clara e Eficaz
6. Organização e Planejamento

PRÉ-REQUISITOS

  1. Formação: Ensino superior concluído em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas
  2. Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  3. Experiência anterior em plataformas de recrutamento e seleção (ex.: LinkedIn, Solides, Inhire, etc.)
  4. Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de design gráfico (ex.: Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
  5. Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campo Grande.

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with you and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers as needed.

  • Advanced working knowledge in electronic circuit design and in commonly used circuit simulators (LTSPICE, PSPICE, etc.) and math tools (Matlab, MathCAD, etc.) applied to embedded systems in harsh environments (O&G, mining or aerospace).
  • Knowledge in power systems demands (Batteries / Recharge / Power management / Passivation / Ramp up / Shut down).

title: Diretor de vendas (RJ)
description:
Grupo FIT Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Você é um(a) líder que acelera com visão estratégica, paixão por gente e foco total em performance? No Grupo FIT, o(a) Diretor(a) é o nosso(a) piloto principal na pista, a liderança máxima da operação. É quem garante que as engrenagens rodem com excelência — da gastronomia à cultura, das vendas aos resultados. Com presença ativa nos boxes e olhar atento ao painel de controle, esse(a) profissional comanda múltiplas lojas e marcas, equilibrando agilidade, disciplina e visão de dono. Aqui, liderar é acelerar junto com o time, fazer pit stops estratégicos e manter o motor da operação rodando com alta performance. Se você quer estar no grid de largada de um time que valoriza gente, entrega e atitude, essa vaga é pra você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Diretor de Vendas no Grupo FIT, você terá uma atuação estratégica e multifacetada, garantindo a excelência em todas as pontas da nossa operação. Suas principais responsabilidades e atribuições incluem :

Visão Estratégica e Gestão do Negócio

Liderar operações com múltiplas marcas, formatos e perfis de loja.

Traduzir a estratégia do Grupo FIT em rotinas práticas e metas objetivas.

Apresentar resultados à diretoria com visão analítica, atitude consultiva e foco em escala.

Conduzir análises de DRE, planejamento financeiro e planos de expansão.

Testar e implementar novos formatos operacionais, com foco em crescimento sustentável.

Controle Financeiro e Resultados

Ser responsável direto por DRE, CMV, CMO, headcount e margem operacional das lojas.

Atuar sobre indicadores como produtividade, jornada, ticket médio e custo de mão de obra.

Liderar planos de recuperação de lojas com baixo desempenho.

Transformar KPIs em ações práticas de curto, médio e longo prazo.

Gestão de Pessoas Cultura

Liderar gerentes e líderes operacionais com protagonismo, escuta e foco em desenvolvimento.

Realizar feedbacks, avaliações de desempenho, planos de ação e sucessão.

Sustentar a cultura FIT na prática diária, sendo referência de atitude, disciplina e coerência.

Atuar junto ao time de Gente & Gestão em clima, engajamento e gestão de talentos.

Acompanhar indicadores de turnover, absenteísmo e clima, com planos preventivos.

Excelência Operacional

Estar presente nas unidades, conduzindo rituais de rotina, checklists e acompanhamentos.

Garantir padrões de limpeza, organização e segurança alimentar (conforme ANVISA e auditorias).

Criar e sustentar rotinas sólidas de abertura, acompanhamento e fechamento.

Controlar estoques, validade e perdas com foco em eficiência operacional e CMV saudável.

Gastronomia, Qualidade e Padrão

Atuar em conjunto com líderes de cozinha, nutricionistas e chefs.

Garantir padrão técnico e sensorial : sabor, montagem, tempo e temperatura.

Apoiar testes e lançamentos de cardápio com visão comercial e foco no cliente.

Vendas, Cliente e Marketing

Liderar times com foco em vendas, ticket médio e metas de atendimento.

Trabalhar junto ao marketing em campanhas e ativações locais.

Monitorar NPS, avaliações online e feedbacks de clientes — agindo com rapidez e inteligência.

Ser referência de postura no salão, especialmente em momentos de pico.

Relação com a Diretoria

Manter relacionamento direto com diretores e VP de Vendas, conciliando visões com foco em resultado.

Ser ponte entre o time operacional e a liderança corporativa.

Promover clareza, alinhamento e foco coletivo, sustentando a cultura de dono em todas as camadas.

Relacionamento com Concessionária (Aeroporto)

Manter relacionamento estratégico com a administração do aeroporto, garantindo conformidade com normas e excelência operacional no ambiente aeroportuário.

Análise e Planejamento

Analisar resultados, mapear processos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação e projetos de otimização de resultados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões com a diretoria, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e decisões ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional com o seguinte perfil e qualificações :

Organizacionais : Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.

Habilidades : Gostar de estar em campo, liderar com presença e transformar desafios em ação. Entender que resultado é reflexo de ritmo, cultura e consistência operacional.

Comportamentais : Comunicação clara e inteligência emocional.

Conhecimentos : Domínio de indicadores financeiros, gestão de pessoas e execução estratégica.

Certificações / Cursos Desejáveis : Formação ou cursos em gestão de negócios, gastronomia, hospitalidade ou áreas correlatas são um diferencial.

Experiência Desejável : Trajetória sólida em operações de varejo, foodservice, hospitalidade ou franquias multiloja.

Informações adicionais

Local de Atuação : Rio de Janeiro

Salário : R$ 10.000,00

Benefícios : Refeição no local + bônus de performance estratégica.

Turnos : Manhã, tarde ou noite, conforme necessidade da loja.

title: Pessoa Diretora de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação
description:
Overview

A Share People hub , em parceria com o Instituto de Clima e Sociedade (ICS ), busca por Pessoa Diretora de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação , para atuação global, com sede fixa em um dos hubs: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília .

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a área de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação, assegurando a representação institucional do ICS, bem como um processo eficiente de captação de recursos e prestação de contas, além de uma receita financeira robusta e sustentável do ICS, coordenando a relação com financiadores, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, de fundos climáticos internacionais, de fontes de programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, de fontes privadas, entre outras.
  • Definir, coordenar e implementar estratégias de captação e relacionamento com financiadores, doadores e parceiros estratégicos, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais, cooperação ao desenvolvimento e fontes privadas, além de identificar e desenvolver novas parcerias.
  • Manter relações e coordenação contínua com financiadores do ICS e outras parceiras estratégicas (tais como instituições similares ao ICS operando em outros países), incluindo gerenciar a coordenação de intercâmbio de informações, conhecimento e diálogo, considerando tendências e necessidades de doadores.
  • Supervisionar a preparação de novas propostas, renovações de apoios e relatórios, garantindo elevada qualidade de textos e documentos apresentados a financiadores.
  • Prospectar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de captação de recursos para o ICS (incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, fontes privadas, entre outras) e desenvolver estratégias para captar e executar tais recursos, contemplando a identificação de arranjos institucionais, potenciais parcerias estratégicas para sua implementação, bem como a elaboração de recomendações e propostas sobre novas formas de captação e execução.
  • Monitorar tendências, prioridades e linhas de financiamento de diferentes fontes, assegurando desenvolvimento constante de recomendações sobre potenciais áreas estratégicas e possíveis considerações operacionais para o ICS.
  • Aprimorar os processos internos de gestão de informação para subsidiar a preparação de propostas e relatórios.
  • Representar a organização em fóruns, eventos e agendas com financiadores, parceiros e iniciativas de cooperação internacional.
  • Co-construir com o departamento programático projetos e narrativas de captação de recursos que respondam às prioridades da organização.
  • Participar ativamente do Grupo Gestor e contribuir para a gestão geral do Instituto.
  • Coordenar as equipes por meio das melhores práticas de gestão de pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Curso superior completo, preferencialmente em Direito, Administração, Ciências Econômicas;
  • Inglês fluente, espanhol será diferencial complementar;
  • Experiência mínima de 12 anos em cargos correlatos de liderança na captação de recursos, em particular relacionados a mudanças do clima, seja no terceiro setor, em agência de cooperação ou em filantropias;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Experiência comprovada em preparação de propostas para financiamento, gestão e relação com doadores e financiadores, gestão de parcerias, relatórios e gestão de fundos;
  • Conhecimento profundo de requerimentos, critérios, indicadores e linha vertical de fundos climáticos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais, conforme demanda.
  • Desejável conhecimento com gestão de monitoramento e regranting;

Sobre o ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Priorizamos medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, especialmente para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é doar para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

Overview

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities:

  • Lead global regulatory strategy and submissions across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Plan, author, and review eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regional requirements and development pathways
  • Provide strategic input on CMC, clinical, and nonclinical documentation for global compliance
  • Coordinate electronic submissions with Regulatory Operations using Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart, and global gateways (FDA ESG, CESP, BfArM, Health Canada, ANVISA)
  • Monitor global regulations and communicate key changes to stakeholders
  • Prepare regulatory correspondence, briefing packages, and materials for health authority meetings
  • Manage post-approval commitments, renewals, and lifecycle activities
  • Review labeling, advertising, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance
  • Maintain relationships with health authorities and industry peers
  • Partner with Quality, Clinical, Nonclinical, and Manufacturing to align regulatory documentation
  • Improve regulatory processes and support audits, inspections, and other regulatory projects

Your Profile

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field required; advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D., Pharm.D.) preferred
  • RAC certification or equivalent highly desirable; ongoing professional development in global regulatory strategy is a plus
  • 8–10 years of global regulatory affairs experience in drug development and lifecycle management across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Strong hands-on experience with global eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Proven success in global registration strategy and interactions with FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ANVISA, NMPA, and other authorities
  • Deep knowledge of ICH guidelines, regional regulations, and global submission standards
  • Proficiency with regulatory information/publishing systems (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart) and electronic gateways
  • Broad understanding of CMC, clinical, and nonclinical regulatory requirements
  • Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a global matrix, handle multiple complex projects, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements

Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
About the Role


The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.


The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.



HSE and Compliance



  • Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.

  • Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.

  • Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.

  • Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.

  • Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.


WORK TASKS


The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.


For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:



  • To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)

  • To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables

  • To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements

  • To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production

  • To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates

  • To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams

  • To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site

  • To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis

  • To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site

  • To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract

  • To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)

  • To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team

  • To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues


About You


You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.


You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).


You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.


You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.

Overview

The Global Customer Operations (GCO) Associate role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment taking inbound calls and requests from SES customers requesting to access SES satellites as well as requests to peak and pol customer antennas. This work requires specific knowledge of radio frequency (RF) technology and Intelsat's satellite network in order to provide the needed level of service to our customers. Associates will receive initial training in order to perform the role, but a general understanding of RF technology and a technical acumen is required.

This team member will manage and maintain incoming customer requests and work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met. The GCO Associate’s role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

What you will do

  • Support customer calls and requests in English, Spanish and Portuguese
  • Able to successfully learn and navigate Web based applications and tools for use in managing customer accounts. This will include Peak and Poles OU Accesses and services for customers within established service level norms; which includes verification of network connectivity and confirmation of network interference.
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue
  • Ensure compliance with SESstandards practices and processes
  • Incorporate and leverage industry best practices while maintaining alignment with SESgoals and capabilities
  • Must be able to maintain customer privacy in compliance with all applicable laws
  • Able to successfully navigate and use Microsoft Office Suite products
  • Manage positive relationships with customers to ensure customer retention
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be able to meet set expectations for call center metrics and customer turnaround times
  • Escalate customer reported technical service issues or requests to the appropriate NOC vertical team
  • Maintain accurate information and data in appropriate systems by tracking and capturing information and data
  • Ability to operate in a team environment cross functionally where employees constantly provide support to each other
  • Flexible and adaptive to change

Your required experience/skills

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • One year of satellite communications experience including an understanding of RF technology
  • One year of proven customer service including relevant experience or equivalent education experience
  • High aptitude for Networking and troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Possess problem analysis and problem resolution skills

Your success in this role will look like:

  • Meet or exceed expectations in gathering and implementing reporting or tool requirements
  • Must be available to work rotating shifts
  • Support network operations center network engineering and sales teams by reduced reducing customer response time and minimizing impact to customers
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication
  • Must be able to work in 24/7/365 environment – includes weekends and holidays

It would be nice if you had:

  • Experience working with Network Operation Centers is a plus but not required
  • Positive attitude with an outgoing disposition

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy.

Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location

Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing.

Leadership and Accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Travel industry experience

  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

This is an opportunity for a Linux Engineer passion for Linux and Customer Success to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have a passion for technology and an eagerness to learn, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full Desktop and Server technical stack at Canonical. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers.

Your day to day job is to provide technical expertise, be an excellent communicator and a service-oriented professional. Every day you will have to make judgement calls to prioritise customer issues and maximise your effectiveness. You will also need to set time aside to learn about our new products and technologies and evolve as a professional. You will participate in various training sessions, team gatherings and Company events.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
  • Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
  • Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
  • Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
  • Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.

What are we looking for in you

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
  • Experience with Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.)
  • Troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to elevate to the correct team.
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the Job

zerohash is looking for an experienced and passionate Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team.

Responsibilities

  • Take an active role as co-owner of production services to ensure they are built, maintained, and operated in a reliable and scalable way.
  • Be part of the successful delivery of new features and services, as well as the day-to-day operations of existing services.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering to identify and help drive operational improvements through metric driven collection and analysis.
  • Develop and maintain performance benchmarks for our applications to ensure a consistent customer experience
  • Help drive operational efficiencies releasing code and monitoring performance.
  • Provide traditional SRE/Operational support scopes like tooling and automation, monitoring, workflow management, maintaining and improving CI/CD, etc.
  • Participate in our weekly on-call rotation to investigate and resolve potential system issues.
  • Get your hands dirty managing and scaling our various infrastructure systems.

Requirements

  • You have extensive experience deploying, managing and troubleshooting infrastructure in AWS.
  • You have managed the full lifecycle of deploying a container to a production environment using self-managed kubernetes, ECS, or EKS.
  • When the perfect tool wasn’t available you wrote one yourself and taught others how to use it.
  • You understand CI/CD and have built custom tooling to deploy code to production environments.
  • You are able to solve problems in distributed Linux systems and are comfortable tracing requests across applications, systems and networks.
  • You hold a CKS certification (kubernetes security)
  • You can automate routine tasks and are proficient in at least two programming languages.
  • You have fantastic communication skills in both spoken and written forms to explain complex ideas to various audiences.
  • You thrive in an environment where collaboration and communication are paramount but are able to solve problems on your own.

Projects you might work on:

  • Creating and maintaining application performance benchmarks so we know when our applications are not performing well.
  • Improving our CI/CD pipeline to reduce the time it takes from development merge to production deployment
  • Continue to improve and scale our AWS and application infrastructure.
  • Work closely with software development to help optimize local development workflow.
  • Identify common issues and come up with solutions on how to reduce their impact or remove them altogether.
  • Help implement a scalable solution for blue/green and canary deployments.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we\'re building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Atividades

  • Através do pedido médico, checar previamente se todo o material necessário para início dos atos operatórios, inclusive materiais consignados, encontram-se à disposição nas salas de cirurgias, priorizando os procedimentos de maior complexidade, a fim de comunicar as respectivas equipes médicas às disponibilidades dos mesmos;
  • Manter a sala cirúrgica de acordo com cada cirurgia e montar a mesa do procedimento utilizando técnica asséptica;
  • Fazer o check-list dos pacientes na admissão e na saída do centro de intervenção cardiovascular, verificando os itens especificados em formulário próprio para cada situação, a fim de garantir a segurança do mesmo;

  • Auxiliar na transferência do paciente da maca para a mesa cirúrgica certificando-se do correto posicionamento do paciente, da placa de bisturi para o ato cirúrgico, bem como dos cateteres, sondas e drenos;
  • Notificar possíveis intercorrências ao enfermeiro responsável, a fim de resolver a situação não planejada;
  • Preencher corretamente todos os impressos pertinentes ao prontuário do paciente e à instituição, registrando todos os procedimentos ocorridos no ato cirúrgico;
  • Controlar a quantidade de materiais, compressas e gazes e equipamentos utilizados pela equipe médica no início da cirurgia, como fator de segurança para o paciente e controle da Unidade;
  • Auxiliar na paramentação da equipe cirúrgica, bem como abrir os materiais estéreis utilizando técnicas assépticas, definida nas normas emitidas pela CCIH;
  • Encaminhar peças, exames, e outros pedidos devidamente protocolados no transcorrer da cirurgia;
  • Auxiliar o anestesiologista na indução / reversão do procedimento anestésico, caso o enfermeiro não tenha condições de estar presente;
  • Realizar a desmontagem da sala cirúrgica, encaminhando materiais à CME;
  • Checar validade de materiais armazenados no arsenal da hemodinâmica;
  • Realizar rotina do setor às 07:00 com registro nos check-list das salas cirúrgicas e Unidade Pós Angioplastia;
